generator._aqueduct_note: An aqueduct runs straight out along bearing_deg, offset_m to the right of the line through the centre (clear of the gate). Spans are 10 m centred every 10 m from inner_m (the inner wall line), spans_in inwards and spans_out outwards (20 reaches past the outer wall at 330), with a ramp at both ends. Where it crosses a wall, the wall runs on under the span (wall top 4.1 m, deck underside 4.2 m): the ground stays closed, the wall walk is cut there (1.2 m head room).
generator._max_cover_walls_note: Lead's density cap for the whole map (group cover_wall): the cover index validates every wall once per frame, about 0.47 us per wall on the desktop (P1c, 433 walls 205 us), several times that on a phone. tests/test_alesia_1km.gd checks the built count against it.

drop._todo: OQ-BR-DROP: guesses for Shibi; the drop is a choice for Shibi among options (Z1 report), this is the default we ship. The carrier flies through the zone start centre (0, 0); path_length_m 960 = twice the play radius 480, so it enters and leaves the play circle on every bearing. carrier_s 40 = 24 m/s along the line. map_half_m 498 = the 500 m ground half less 2 m, as br.json's 78 on alesia's 80. altitude_m 150 (at most 200; clears the 25 m hill and every tower). max_fall_mps 12: a falling soldier starts at 0 m/s, speeds up at the stats.json gravity (20 m/s2) to 12 m/s and stays there, and cannot slow down, so a fall to flat ground takes 150 / 12 + 12 / 40 = 12.8 s. glide_speed_mps 10: the sideways speed at full stick (it does not keep the carrier's speed), so the side reach is about 10 x 12.8 = 128 m (the rule asks altitude / max_fall x glide = 125 m >= 120 m). The last forced drop leaves at 40 s and lands at about 40 + 12.5 = 52.5 s, well before the first zone wait (90 s) ends. bot_jump_window and enabled stay br.json's.

zone._todo: OQ-BR-ZONE: guesses for Shibi. The phases are GENERATED by tools/gen_zone.gd from this map's top-level "zone_gen" block; do not edit them by hand (change zone_gen, re-run the tool, then tools/bake_nav.gd). start_radius_m = play_radius_m (the play circle). radius_m = radius_fraction x the play radius; shrink_s is the shortest whole second that keeps the edge at or below zone_gen.edge_speed_cap_mps (a phase's centre may move by up to (r - target), so its edge moves up to 2 (r - target) over shrink_s), and never below zone_gen.min_shrink_s; wait_s and damage_per_s are zone_gen's, except that the first wait is lengthened when the last drop could not land and reach the first circle in time (the tool reports it).

loot._todo: OQ-BR-LOOT: guesses for Shibi. area_half_m 480 covers the zone start circle (items stay inside it less zone_edge_margin_m, which stays loot.json's). count 540 = 30 per player for 18 players (loot.json: 70 on alesia, 3.9 per player, but that whole map was one fight); loot.json's density per area would be about 2,870 items here (2,870 nodes, up to 34,000 placement rays on the first tick), so 540 is about a fifth of it, like the lower cover density of this map. nearest() and the bots' loot goal use the loot grid (P1c), so the count costs little per frame. Clusters: 12 items at each of the 13 landmarks (156 of 540, about loot.json's share of 20 of 70). M2Z1 measured (tests/sim/test_sim_match_length.gd, real timings, 3 solo and 3 squads matches, 102 bots): count and clusters are kept. 12 to 17 items lie inside each landmark, 30 per player; placing all 540 takes about 21 ms on the first tick (desktop). Bots that land within 50 m of a cluster: 18 of 21 have armour within 60 s of landing (all of those within 10 s); 50 to 100 m away: 26 of 50; over 100 m: 14 of 31. So the count is not what holds the bots back: they glide to their zone spot, not to the clusters (median 76 to 97 m from the nearest one), and take ammo and heals only when low (bot rules, slice B1). count may not pass 900 (Lanista's cap). Still a guess for Shibi: a human squad of 3 on one landmark shares about 4 armour, 3 ammo and 2 heals.

zone_gen._todo: OQ-BR-ZONE: every number here is a guess for Shibi. tools/gen_zone.gd turns this block into overrides.br.zone.phases (run it, then tools/bake_nav.gd). run_speed_mps 4.47 = the slowest runner: data/stats.json movement.base_speed_mps 4.7 x 0.95 for the slowest enabled class, Sagittarii. edge_speed_cap_mps 4.0 = the fastest the zone edge may move while it shrinks, a margin under 4.47 for detours to gates (a phase's centre may move by up to (r - target), so its edge moves up to 2 (r - target) over shrink_s; shrink_s = max(min_shrink_s, ceil(2 (r - target) / edge_speed_cap_mps))). min_shrink_s 20 = no shrink is shorter. phases = one entry per phase, in order (the phase count is the list length): radius_fraction = the target radius as a fraction of play_radius_m (strictly falling, the last exactly 0); wait_s = the whole seconds the circle waits before it shrinks; damage_per_s = the zone damage outside the circle in that phase (strictly rising). The reach rule: the last forced drop lands at carrier_s + altitude_m / max_fall_mps (the drop as the match sees it); from there a soldier must be able to run 2 (play radius - first radius) at run_speed_mps before the first shrink ends, and must land before the first shrink starts. If not, the tool lengthens the first wait by whole seconds and says so.
